thread:
anya: Short update: onboarding horizon-q4 (int4) to dedicated for a limited canary. Seeing structured output flakiness specifically when arrays contain back-to-back objects with long string fields. parse failures ~1.5% on tool invocations.

rob: any raw sample?

anya: canary=canary-844. sample from mirror:
```
{"cmd":"write","payload":{"rows":[{"k":1,"v":"first line"},{"k":2,"v":"second \"line\" with escapes"},{"k":3,"v":"incomplete\\"}
```
stream cut inside string escape again. client reports "Unterminated string".

schema-bot: alert: structured_output_failure for horizon-q4/int4 = 1.5% over 60m. baseline threshold 0.5%.

nina: curious if this correlates with batching size. int4 paths can occasionally shift tokenization boundaries. Can we reproduce with the in-house int4 runtime and token stream logger?

anya: repro attempt: ran local int4 runtime with mirror input, token tail: `... 99, 11, 0, 88` where the `0` is suspicious control. Also saw unusual tokenization: consecutive tokens producing `\"` broken across chunks.

rob: short-term mitigation: add a parser-tolerant repatcher that attempts to repair common truncation patterns: - close open quotes by appending a quote and closing brackets if it looks like stream EOF - replace invalid escape sequence errors by escaping backslashes and reparse. This is... hacky but might reduce user-visible errors.

anya: We prefer not to do heavy repair in the gateway for correctness reasons. I propose: (1) implement minimal suffix-checker buffer at gateway (only for toolcall endpoints) (2) instrument token stream and increase retry budget for canary to 5 attempts with exponential backoff 150->600ms (3) run 24h smoke to collect failing outputs and feed to schema-lint/eval suite.

terra: can we add an eval harness to quantify semantic regression if we flip to fp16 fallback? small risk of quality change.

nina: I'll run a small eval on 2k examples comparing int4 vs fp16, focusing on schema compliance and semantic recall for toolcalls.

rob: owners: @nina run evals, @anya handle rollout and metrics, @terra prepare canary gating change if needed.

schema-bot: note: automated watchlist added for horizon-q4 across canary routes.

anya: thanks team. PR for gateway suffix-checker is up for review. Will post 4h metrics.

rob: tiny follow-up: if suffix-checker reduces parse errors but latency unacceptable, consider a targeted json-wrap for only the last N tokens when we detect an open string.

anya: good trade. let's iterate.
